enabled.description: Enable or disable the telephony service daemon entirely.

pid_file.description: Full path where the daemon writes its process ID.

user.description: System user account under which the service runs.

group.description: System group for the telephony service processes.

log_dir.description: Directory where telephony service logs are written.

syslog.description: Forward logs to the system logger (syslog/journald).

dialer_enabled.description: Enable integration with the system dialer app.

call_limit.description: Maximum number of simultaneous active calls allowed.

outgoing_timeout.description: Seconds to wait before aborting an outgoing call setup.

max_dial_retries.description: Maximum number of retry attempts for dialing a number.

ril_backend.description: RIL backend to use for modem communication (e.g., 'qmi', 'at', 'mock').

ril_device.description: Path to the serial device or control interface for the modem.

default_apn.description: Default APN used for mobile data connectivity.

apn_auth_type.description: Authentication type for the default APN.

apn_username.description: Username for APN authentication (leave empty if not required).

apn_password.description: Password for APN authentication (leave empty if not required).

ussd_enabled.description: Enable support for Unstructured Supplementary Service Data (USSD).

sms_enabled.description: Enable SMS sending, receiving, and storage.

max_sms_retain.description: Maximum number of SMS messages retained in storage.

smsc.description: Service Center number (SMSC) override. Leave empty to use modem default.

delivery_reports.description: Request delivery status reports for outgoing SMS.

gnss_enabled.description: Enable GNSS (GPS) assistance for location-based features and call routing.

gnss_device.description: NMEA serial device path for GPS data.

nmea_rate.description: Update interval (seconds) for NMEA sentences (1–10 seconds).

gnss_timeout.description: Maximum wait time (seconds) for a valid GNSS fix before giving up.

mobile_data_auto_connect.description: Automatically establish a data connection on service startup.

mobile_data_background.description: Allow background mobile data usage for services like push notifications.
